analysis:
Examined the Autopilot residency changes.

ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift (head 20-81) builds the snapshot locally. It attaches the new protocol-3+ fields only when autopilotConsented is true; autopilotConsented excludes privateOnly (AutopilotControl.swift:8-10). Those fields are capabilities, adopted/held models, busy reasons/since and transition stalls. Without consent, the busy clock is reset.

Busy evaluation moved to AutopilotBusy.swift:7-41. Its reasons map 1:1 to the base busy expression at base Autopilot.swift:123-129. The .autopilotOperation reason returns false, matching the base policy input. The only new busy reason is that heartbeat reporting adds an accepted operation.

Status detail is consent-gated at emission (head 277). It exposes only enum busy-reason strings and AutopilotFailure codes to the trusted coordinator. This is no plaintext or key exposure (A-001/A-003 unaffected).

New Task.checkCancellation calls (head 217, 224) prevent a cancelled or stalled operation from reporting success or recording a lease/placement. This strengthens fail-closed behavior. Command history now stores a detail field, and replay behavior is unchanged.

The AutopilotInventory.swift:15 (head) change matters most. withdrawInactiveAutopilotModels now keeps an inventory model advertised without a live lease when autopilotAdoptionIsValid(id) is true. This relaxes the documented invariant at AutopilotControl.swift:51-52 ('Inventory is observational until a valid live lease'). The supplied units do not include the source for autopilotAdoptionIsValid, reconcileAutopilotPlacements or recordAutopilotPlacement. Integration must therefore verify the following.
- Adoption validity requires current consent, a non-privateOnly setting, the selected/allowed model, an unfailed self-test hash and a non-retiring model.
- Adoption is invalidated on consent revocation, pause, settings revision change and disconnect.
- Adoption is tied to a command that actually succeeded. Placement is recorded only after the cancellation check at head 224-228.

Also unseen is beginModelAdvertisementOccurrence (Inventory head 69). Advertising still requires a weightHash (base Inventory:55). Coordinator weight-hash and routing gates (TB-002, T-027) still apply.

No concrete regression is established from the visible evidence. Deeper review is requested because of the unseen adoption-validity logic.
